proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp
  | @comp u v p q h r => simp [r, ← FreeSListQuiv.cons_map_def]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.ainfToPerm_w₂_apply_lt_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing i with
  | id => simpa using hi
  | @comp L₁ L₂ L₃ p q hp =>
    simp only [FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList, toList_length] at hp hi
    have hl₁₂ : L₁.length = L₂.length := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
    have hl₂₃ : L₂.length = L₃.length := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom ((FreeSListQuiv.ι _).map q)
    simp only [weight.weight_comp, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, labelling₂, map_mul,
      AinfToPerm_simple, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Function.comp_apply, FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList,
      toList_length, gt_iff_lt]
    apply hp
    grind [labelling₀_lt q]

name: List.getElem_of_eq'
statement:
theorem _root_.List.getElem_of_eq' {α : Type*} {l : List α} {i i' : Nat} (h : i = i')
    (w : i < l.length) :
    l[i] = l[i']'(h ▸ w)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply'
statement:
private lemma getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply'
    {L₁ L₂ : SListQuiv C}
    (f : L₁.Hom L₂) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < L₂.toList.length) :
    (L₂.toList)[i] =
    (L₁.toList)[(AinfToPerm (w₂.app (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map f))) i]'
      (ainfToPerm_w₂_apply_lt_of_lt (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map f) _ hi)
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing i with grind [labelling₂, labelling₀, AinfToPerm_simple]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply
statement:
private lemma getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply {L₁ L₂ : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : L₁ ⟶ L₂)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < L₂.length) :
    (L₂.toList)[i] =
      (L₁.toList)[AinfToPerm (w₂.app f) i]'(ainfToPerm_w₂_apply_lt_of_lt f _ hi)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing i with
  | id => simp
  | @comp l₁ l₂ l₃ p q hr =>
    simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList, weight.weight_comp,
      FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, map_mul, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Function.comp_apply] at hi ⊢ hr
    have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
    have := getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply' q
    simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι] at this
    rw [this i hi]
    have : (AinfToPerm (labelling₂ q)) i < l₂.length := by
      simpa using ainfToPerm_w₂_apply_lt_of_lt
        ((FreeSListQuiv.ι C).map q) i hi
    exact hr (AinfToPerm (labelling₂ q) i) this

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.wFin_app_eq'
statement:
lemma wFin_app_eq' (n : ℕ) {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    (wFin n).app f = PresentedMonoid.mk _ ((w₀Fin n).app f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp
  | comp p q h => simp [h, finLabelling₁Mon, AₙLabelling]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.w₂_app_eq_of_homEquiv
statement:
lemma w₂_app_eq_of_homEquiv
    {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f g : i ⟶ j) (h : FreeSListQuiv.HomEquiv C f g) :
    w₂.app f = w₂.app g
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | swap_naturality X Y f =>
    simp only [weight.weight_comp, w₂_swap, w₂_app_consPath, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι]
    have e := Ainf.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_pow 0 (labelling₀ f + 1 + 1)
    simp only [Ainf_M, Matrix.of_apply, Nat.right_eq_add, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
      and_false, ↓reduceIte, one_ne_zero, and_self, zero_add, or_self, pow_two,
      mul_eq_one_iff_inv_eq, mul_inv_rev, CoxeterSystem.inv_simple] at e
    simpa [labelling₂, CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple] using e.symm
  | swap_swap X Y l => simp
  | triple X Y Z l =>
    simp only [weight.weight_comp, w₂_swap, w₂_app_consPath, Ainf.shift_simple 1, zero_add]
    have e := Ainf.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_pow 0 1
    simp only [Ainf_M, Matrix.of_apply, zero_ne_one, ↓reduceIte, Nat.reduceAdd,
      OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, zero_add, or_true, pow_three, mul_eq_one_iff_inv_eq, mul_inv_rev,
      CoxeterSystem.inv_simple] at e
    have := congr($e * Ainf.toCoxeterSystem.simple 1)
    simpa [← mul_assoc] using this.symm
  | cons X f f' h₀ hrec => grind [w₂_app_consPath]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.w₂_app_eq_of_compClosure_homEquiv
statement:
lemma w₂_app_eq_of_compClosure_homEquiv {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f g : i ⟶ j)
    (h : (HomRel.CompClosure (FreeSListQuiv.HomEquiv C)) f g) :
    w₂.app f = w₂.app g
proof:
:= by
  cases h with | intro i j f m₁ m₂ g h =>
  simpa using w₂_app_eq_of_homEquiv m₁ m₂ h

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toAinf_π
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma toAinf_π {l l' : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : l ⟶ l') :
    toAinf.app ((π C).map f) = w₂.app f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toAinf, weight.app_mk]
  generalize_proofs h
  simp [lift_π_obj (h := h), lift_π_map (h := h), weight.app_eq]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toAinf_swap
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma toAinf_swap (x y : C) (l : SList C) :
    toAinf.app (β~ x y l) = Ainf.simple 0

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toAinf_cons
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma toAinf_cons (x : C) {l l' : SList C} (f : l ⟶ l') :
    toAinf.app ((x>~).map f) = Ainf.shift 1 (toAinf.app f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toAinf, weight.app_mk]
  induction f with | @h u v f =>
  generalize_proofs h
  change ((lift w₂.F h).map (π C |>.map <| x ::_ₘ f)).unop = _
  simp [weight.app_eq, SList.lift_π_obj (h := h), SList.lift_π_map (h := h)]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toPerm_swap
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma toPerm_swap (x y : C) (l : SList C) :
    toPerm.app (β~ x y l) = Equiv.swap 0 1

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toPerm_app_cons_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma toPerm_app_cons_apply_zero (x : C) {l l' : SList C} (f : l ⟶ l') :
    toPerm.app ((x>~).map f) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toPerm, weight.postComp_app, toAinf_cons]
  generalize toAinf.app f = u
  induction u using Ainf.toCoxeterSystem.simple_induction with
  | simple i => simp only [Ainf.shift_simple' 1, AinfToPerm_simple]; grind
  | one => simp
  | mul w w' h₀ h₀' => simp [h₀, h₀']

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toPerm_app_cons_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma toPerm_app_cons_apply_succ (x : C) {l l' : SList C} (f : l ⟶ l') (k : ℕ) :
    toPerm.app ((x>~).map f) (k + 1) = (toPerm.app f) k + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toPerm, weight.postComp_app, toAinf_cons]
  generalize toAinf.app f = u
  induction u using Ainf.toCoxeterSystem.simple_induction generalizing k with
  | simple i => simp only [Ainf.shift_simple' 1, AinfToPerm_simple]; grind
  | one => simp
  | mul w w' h₀ h₀' => simp [h₀, h₀']

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toPerm_app_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem toPerm_app_eq_of_lt {x y : SList C} (f : x ⟶ y) (k : ℕ) (hk : y.length ≤ k) :
    (toPerm.app f) k = k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toPerm, weight.postComp_app]
  induction f using SList.hom_induction with | h f =>
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp
  | comp p q hq =>
    have := SListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom q
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, weight.weight_comp, toAinf_π, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι,
      labelling₂, map_mul, AinfToPerm_simple, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Function.comp_apply]
    have := labelling₀_lt q
    grind

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toPerm_app_lt_of_lt
statement:
@[grind .]
theorem toPerm_app_lt_of_lt {L₁ L₂ : SList C} (f : L₁ ⟶ L₂) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < L₂.length) :
    (toPerm.app f) k < L₁.length
proof:
:= by
  by_contra!
  have := toPerm_app_eq_of_lt (inv f) (toPerm.app f k) this
  simp only [weight.app_inv, Equiv.Perm.coe_inv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
  grind [SList.length_eq_of_hom f]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.getElem_toList_toPerm
statement:
theorem getElem_toList_toPerm {L₁ L₂ : SList C} (f : L₁ ⟶ L₂) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < L₂.length) :
    L₂.toList[i] = L₁.toList[toPerm.app f i]'(toPerm_app_lt_of_lt f i hi)
proof:
:= by
  cases f with | @h x y f =>
  simp only [π_obj_toList, toPerm, weight.postComp_app, toAinf_π]
  exact getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply f _ _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_labelling₀_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction f using SListQuiv.induction with
  | sw x y l =>
    cases g using SListQuiv.induction with
    | sw x y l => rfl
    | cons z g => simp [labelling₀] at h
  | cons z f hr =>
    cases g using SListQuiv.induction with
    | sw x y l => simp [labelling₀] at h
    | cons z f =>
      simp only [labelling₀, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h
      obtain rfl := hr h
      rfl

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_labelling₀_eq'
proof:
:= by
  induction f using SListQuiv.induction generalizing k with
  | sw x y l => cases g using SListQuiv.induction with
    | cons z _ => simp [labelling₀] at h
    | sw x y l => rfl
  | cons z f hr => cases g using SListQuiv.induction with
    | sw x y l => simp [labelling₀] at h
    | cons z _ =>
      simp only [labelling₀, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h
      obtain rfl := hr h
      rfl

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_labelling₀_eq''
proof:
:= by
  induction f using SListQuiv.induction generalizing k with
  | sw x y l => cases g using SListQuiv.induction with
    | cons z _ => simp [labelling₀] at h
    | sw x y l => rfl
  | cons z f hr => cases g using SListQuiv.induction with
    | sw x y l => simp [labelling₀] at h
    | cons z _ =>
      simp only [labelling₀, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h
      obtain rfl := hr h
      rfl

name: FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of
statement:
lemma _root_.FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of {α : Type*} {u v : FreeMonoid α} {a a' : α}
    (h : u * (.of a) = v * (.of a')) : u = v ∧ a = a'
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : a = a' by
    subst h
    simpa using h
  have toList_eq := congr(FreeMonoid.toList $h)
  have length_eq := congr(List.length $toList_eq)
  simp only [FreeMonoid.toList_mul, FreeMonoid.toList_of, List.length_append,
    List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at toList_eq length_eq
  simpa [length_eq] using congr(List.drop (FreeMonoid.toList u).length $toList_eq)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀_app_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_w₀_app_eq {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} {f g : i ⟶ j} (h : w₀.app f = w₀.app g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | @comp i j k p q h' =>
      have := congr(FreeMonoid.length $h)
      simp [labelling₁Mon] at this
    | id => rfl
  | @comp u v w p q h' =>
    cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id =>
      have := congr(FreeMonoid.length $h)
      simp [labelling₁Mon] at this
    | @comp u' v' w' p' q' h'' =>
      simp only [weight.weight_comp, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, labelling₁Mon] at h
      have : labelling₀ q = labelling₀ q' := (FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of h).2
      obtain rfl : v = v' := eq_of_labelling₀_eq'' this
      obtain rfl : q = q' := eq_of_labelling₀_eq this
      simp only [mul_left_inj] at h
      obtain rfl := h' h
      rfl

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.w₂_app_eq''
statement:
@[simp]
lemma w₂_app_eq'' (n : ℕ) {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : i ⟶ j) (hn : n + 2 = i.length) :
    AnToAinfMonoid _ ((wFin n).app f) = Ainf.groupToMonoid (w₂.app f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp [w₂]
  | @comp u v p q h r =>
    have := AₙLabelling_to_Ainf n h <| by
      have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom q
      grind
    simp [this, labelling₂Mon, r hn]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀_app_eq'
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing k with
  | id =>
    cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => rfl
    | comp p q _ =>
      symm at h
      simp [labelling₁Mon] at h
  | @comp u v w p q r => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp [labelling₁Mon] at h
    | @comp u' v' w' p' q' r' =>
      simp only [weight.weight_comp, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, labelling₁Mon,
        forall_const] at h r r'
      have := FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of h
      grind [eq_of_labelling₀_eq', eq_of_labelling₀_eq]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀_eq''
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing j with
  | id =>
    cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => rfl
    | comp p q _ =>
      symm at h
      simp [labelling₁Mon] at h
  | @comp u v w p q r => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp [labelling₁Mon] at h
    | @comp u' v' w' p' q' r' =>
      simp only [weight.weight_comp, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, labelling₁Mon,
        forall_const] at h r r'
      have := FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of h
      obtain rfl : v = v' := eq_of_labelling₀_eq'' this.2
      grind [eq_of_labelling₀_eq', eq_of_labelling₀_eq]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.w₀Fin_consPath_map
statement:
lemma w₀Fin_consPath_map (n : ℕ) {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : i ⟶ j) (x : C)
      (hn : i.length <= n + 2) :
    (w₀Fin (n + 1)).app (x ::_ₘ f) = succMon _ (w₀Fin n |>.app f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp
  | @comp u v w p q r =>
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, ← FreeSListQuiv.cons_map_def, weight.weight_comp, r hn,
        FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, finLabelling₁Mon, finLabelling₀, labelling₀,
        Fin.ofNat_eq_cast, map_mul, FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, mul_right_inj]
      congr
      ext
      simp only [Fin.val_natCast, Fin.val_succ]
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] <;>
      · have := labelling₀_lt q
        simp at hn
        have l₁ : u.length = v.length := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
        rw [← l₁] at this
        grind

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.w₀_consPath_map
statement:
lemma w₀_consPath_map {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : i ⟶ j) (x : C) :
    w₀.app (x ::_ₘ f) = shift'Mon 1 (w₀.app f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp
  | @comp u v w p q r => simpa [← FreeSListQuiv.cons_map_def, labelling₁Mon, labelling₀] using r

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.w₀_prependPath_map
statement:
lemma w₀_prependPath_map (l : FreeSListQuiv C) {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    w₀.app (l ++ₘ f) = shift'Mon l.length (w₀.app f)
proof:
:= by
  cases l with | h l =>
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp
    | @comp u v w p q r =>
      simp [labelling₁Mon, FreeSListQuiv.append_nil_map]
  | cons z l' r' =>
    induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp
    | @comp u v w p q r =>
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, length_cons, Functor.map_comp,
        weight.weight_comp, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, map_mul] at r r'
      simp [FreeSListQuiv.cons_obj_eq, FreeSListQuiv.append_cons_map, w₀_consPath_map,
        ← map_mul, r', shift'Mon_self]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.valEmb_w₀Fin
statement:
lemma valEmb_w₀Fin {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f : i ⟶ j) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : i.length = n + 2) :
    valEmb _ (w₀Fin n |>.app f) = w₀.app f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
  | id => simp
  | @comp u v w p q r =>
    have := labelling₀_lt q;
    have l₁ : u.length = v.length := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
    have := r hn
    simp [finLabelling₁Mon, finLabelling₀, r hn, labelling₁Mon,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (a := labelling₀ q) (b := n + 1) (by grind [Paths.of_obj])]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀Fin_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_w₀Fin_eq {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} {f g : i ⟶ j} (n : ℕ)
    (hn : i.length = n + 2) (h : (w₀Fin n).app f = (w₀Fin n).app g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing n with
  | id => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp
    | comp p q _ => symm at h; simp [finLabelling₁Mon] at h
  | @comp u v w p q hr => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp [finLabelling₁Mon] at h
    | @comp u' v' w p' q' r' =>
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, weight.weight_comp,
        FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, finLabelling₁Mon, forall_const] at hr h r'
      have := FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of h
      have l_e := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p'
      have l_e' := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length] at l_e l_e' hn p
      simp only [finLabelling₀, Fin.ofNat_eq_cast, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_natCast] at this
      have e : w₀.app p = w₀.app p' := by
        have := congr(valEmb _ $(this.1))
        rwa [valEmb_w₀Fin, valEmb_w₀Fin] at this <;> grind
      simp only [weight.weight_comp, e, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, labelling₁Mon, mul_right_inj]
      congr 1
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] at this
      · grind
      · have := labelling₀_lt q'
        grind
      · have := labelling₀_lt q
        simp
        grind

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀Fin_eq'
statement:
lemma eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' {i j k : FreeSListQuiv C} {f : i ⟶ j} {g : i ⟶ k} (n : ℕ)
    (hn : i.length = n + 2) (h : (w₀Fin n).app f = (w₀Fin n).app g) :
    j = k
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq' (f := f) (g := g)
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing n with
  | id => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp
    | comp p q _ => symm at h; simp [finLabelling₁Mon] at h
  | @comp u v w p q hr => cases g using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction with
    | id => simp [finLabelling₁Mon] at h
    | @comp u' v' w p' q' r' =>
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, weight.weight_comp,
        FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, finLabelling₁Mon, forall_const] at hr h r'
      have := FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of h
      have l_e := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p'
      have l_e' := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, finLabelling₀, Fin.ofNat_eq_cast,
        Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_natCast, weight.weight_comp,
        FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι] at l_e l_e' p this hn ⊢
      have e : w₀.app p = w₀.app p' := by
        have := congr(valEmb _ $(this.1))
        rwa [valEmb_w₀Fin, valEmb_w₀Fin] at this <;> grind
      simp only [e, labelling₁Mon, mul_right_inj]
      congr 1
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] at this
      · grind
      · have := labelling₀_lt q'
        grind
      · have := labelling₀_lt q
        grind

name: List.eq_cons_cons_of_length_eq_add_two
statement:
private lemma _root_.List.eq_cons_cons_of_length_eq_add_two {n : ℕ}
    (l : List C) (h : l.length = n + 2) : ∃ (a b : C) (l' : List C), l = a::b::l'
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.twoStepInduction <;> grind

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.exists_hom_of_weight_eq
statement:
lemma exists_hom_of_weight_eq (i : FreeSListQuiv C) (n : ℕ) (hj : i.length = n + 2)
    (w : FreeMonoid (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∃ j : FreeSListQuiv C, ∃ f : i ⟶ j, (w₀Fin n).app f = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing i with
  | one =>
    use i, (𝟙 _)
    simp
  | of x =>
    cases i with |_ i
    induction i generalizing n with
    | nil => grind
    | cons a l r =>
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hj
      cases x using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
        cases l with
        | nil => grind
        | cons b l =>
          use (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj ( b ::… a ::… l)),
            (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map <| .swap a b l)
          simp only [FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι]
          rfl
      | succ i =>
        cases n with
        | zero => exact i.elim0
        | succ n =>
          obtain ⟨j₀, f₀, hj₀⟩ := r n i hj
          use (a ::_ j₀), (a ::_ₘ f₀)
          simp [w₀Fin_consPath_map n f₀ a (by grind), hj₀]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨j₀, f₀, rfl⟩ := hx i hj
    obtain ⟨j₁, f₁, rfl⟩ := hy j₀ (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₀ ▸ hj)
    use j₁, f₀ ≫ f₁
    simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.exists_cons_eq_of_weight_eq_shift_quiv
statement:
private lemma exists_cons_eq_of_weight_eq_shift_quiv
    {w : FreeMonoid ℕ} {i j : SListQuiv C}
    {f : i ⟶ j}
    (h : w₀.app (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map f) = shift'Mon 1 w) (hij : 1 ≤ i.length) :
    ∃ x : C, ∃ i' j' : SListQuiv C, ∃ (f' : i' ⟶ j'),
    ∃ hi : (x ::… i') = i, ∃ hj : (x ::… j') = j,
    (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map f) =
    eqToHom (by rw [← hi]; rfl) ≫
      (FreeSListQuiv.cons x |>.map (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map f')) ≫
      eqToHom (by rw [← hj]; rfl)
proof:
:= by
  cases f using SListQuiv.induction with
  | sw x y l =>
    simp only [FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, ← FreeSListQuiv.cons_map_def, cons.injEq] at h ⊢
    cases w with
    | h0 => simp [labelling₁Mon] at h
    | ih x xs =>
      simp only [labelling₁Mon, labelling₀, map_mul, FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of] at h
      have := congr(FreeMonoid.length $h)
      simp only [FreeMonoid.length_of, FreeMonoid.length_mul, Nat.left_eq_add,
        FreeMonoid.length_eq_zero] at this
      simp only [this, mul_one] at h
      have := FreeMonoid.of_injective h
      simp at this
  | @cons x i j f =>
    use x, i, j, f, rfl, rfl
    simp [← FreeSListQuiv.cons_map_def]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.exists_cons_eq_of_weight_eq_shift
statement:
lemma exists_cons_eq_of_weight_eq_shift
    {w : FreeMonoid ℕ} {i j : FreeSListQuiv C}
    {f : i ⟶ j}
    (h : w₀.app f = shift'Mon 1 w) (hij : 1 ≤ i.length) :
    ∃ x : C, ∃ i' j' : FreeSListQuiv C, ∃ (f' : i' ⟶ j'),
    ∃ hi : (x ::_ i') = i, ∃ hj : (x ::_ j') = j,
    f = eqToHom hi.symm ≫ (x ::_ₘ f') ≫ eqToHom hj
proof:
:= by
  induction f using FreeSListQuiv.hom_induction generalizing w with
  | @id i' =>
      simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length] at hij
      obtain ⟨k, t⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij
      cases i' with | nil => grind | cons x i₀ =>
      use x, i₀, i₀, 𝟙 _
      simp [← FreeSListQuiv.cons_obj_eq]
  | @comp i' j' k' p q hr =>
      have u := w.reverse_reverse
      rw [← u] at h
      generalize w.reverse = w' at h
      cases w' with
      | h0 =>
        have : FreeMonoid.reverse (α := ℕ) 1 = 1 := rfl
        simp [this, labelling₁Mon] at h
      | ih x xs =>
        simp only [weight.weight_comp, FreeSListQuiv.mkWeight_app_ι, FreeMonoid.reverse_mul,
          FreeMonoid.reverse_of, map_mul] at h
        
        
        dsimp [labelling₁Mon] at h
        have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom p
        simp only [toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length] at this hij
        obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := FreeMonoid.mul_eq_of_eq_mul_of h
        obtain ⟨x₀, i₀, j₀, f₀, hi₀, hj₀, hf₀⟩ := hr h₁ hij
        obtain ⟨x₁, i₁, j₁, f₁, hi₁, hj₁, hf₁⟩ :=
          exists_cons_eq_of_weight_eq_shift_quiv (f := q) (w := .of x)
            (by simpa [labelling₁Mon] using congr(FreeMonoid.of $h₂)) (by grind)
        obtain rfl : x₀ = x₁ := by
          rw [← hi₁, FreeSListQuiv.cons_obj_eq] at hj₀
          have := congr(FreeSListQuiv.toList $hj₀)
          grind [FreeSListQuiv.cons_toList, FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList]
        obtain rfl : j₀ = i₁ := by
          rw [← hi₁, FreeSListQuiv.cons_obj_eq] at hj₀
          have := congr(FreeSListQuiv.toList $hj₀)
          apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
          grind
        use x₀, i₀, j₁, f₀ ≫ (FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.map f₁), hi₀,
          congr(FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj $hj₁)
        rw [hf₀, hf₁]
        simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀Fin_monoidRelations
statement:
lemma eq_of_w₀Fin_monoidRelations {L₁ L₂ L₃ : FreeSListQuiv C}
    {f : L₁ ⟶ L₂} {g : L₁ ⟶ L₃} (n : ℕ)
    (hn : L₁.length = n + 2)
    (h : (CoxeterMatrix.Aₙ <| n + 1).monoidRelations (w₀Fin n |>.app f) (w₀Fin n |>.app g)) :
    L₂ = L₃
proof:
:= by
  generalize hv : (w₀Fin n).app f = v at h
  generalize hw : (w₀Fin n).app g = w at h
  cases h with | intro i' j' =>
  obtain rfl : L₃ = L₁ := by
    have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f
    have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom g
    apply eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' n (g := 𝟙 L₁) (f := g) (by grind)
    simpa
  clear hw g
  cases L₂ with | h L₂ =>
  cases L₃ with | h L₃ =>
  apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
  apply List.ext_getElem (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f).symm
  intro i hi hi'
  simp_rw [FreeSListQuiv.equiv_ι_obj]
  have := getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply (f := f) i
    (by grind [FreeSListQuiv.equiv_ι_obj])
  simp only [FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList] at this
  rw [this]
  suffices w₂.app f = 1 by simp [this]
  have := w₂_app_eq' f
  replace hv := congr(valEmb _ $hv)
  simp only [valEmb_w₀Fin _ _ hn] at hv
  rw [hv] at this
  simp only [map_pow, map_mul, FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, PresentedMonoid.mk_of,
    ← Ainf.groupToMonoid_simple] at this
  rw [← map_mul (f := Ainf.groupToMonoid), ← map_pow (f := Ainf.groupToMonoid),
    ← CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple, Aₙ_m_eq,
    Ainf.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_pow] at this
  have : Function.Injective Ainf.groupToMonoid := Ainf.monoidToGroupMulEquiv.toEquiv.symm.injective
  grind

name: CategoryTheory.SList.SListQuiv.eq_of_w₀Fin_congen_rel
statement:
lemma eq_of_w₀Fin_congen_rel {i j k : FreeSListQuiv C} {f : i ⟶ j} {g : i ⟶ k} (n : ℕ)
    (hn : i.length = n + 2)
    (h : ConGen.Rel (CoxeterMatrix.Aₙ (n + 1)).monoidRelations
      (w₀Fin n |>.app f) (w₀Fin n |>.app g)) :
    j = k
proof:
:= by
  generalize hv : (w₀Fin n).app f = v at h
  generalize hw : (w₀Fin n).app g = w at h
  induction h generalizing i j k f g with
  | of x y r =>
    subst hv
    subst hw
    exact eq_of_w₀Fin_monoidRelations n hn r
  | refl x => exact eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' n hn (hw ▸ hv)
  | symm r hr => exact hr hn hw hv|>.symm
  | @trans u v w r r' hr hr' =>
    obtain ⟨j', f', hf'⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq i n hn v
    obtain rfl := hr hn hv hf'
    have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f
    exact hr' (by grind) hf' hw
  | @mul u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ r₁ r₂ hr₁ hr₂ =>
    obtain ⟨k₁, f₁, hf₁⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq i n hn u₁
    obtain ⟨j₁, g₁, hg₁⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq k₁ n
      (by have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₁; grind) v₁
    obtain ⟨k₂, f₂, hf₂⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq i n hn u₂
    obtain ⟨j₂, g₂, hg₂⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq k₂ n
      (by have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₂; grind) v₂
    obtain rfl : j = j₁ := eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' (f := f) (g := f₁ ≫ g₁) n hn (by grind)
    obtain rfl : k = j₂ := eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' (f := g) (g := f₂ ≫ g₂) n hn (by grind)
    obtain rfl := hr₁ hn hf₁ hf₂
    exact hr₂ (by have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₁; grind) hg₁ hg₂

name: CategoryTheory.SList.map_eq_of_label_eq_sq
statement:
private theorem map_eq_of_label_eq_sq (k : ℕ) {L : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (hk : L.length = k + 2)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k + 1)
    (f : L ⟶ L) (hwf : w₀.app f = FreeMonoid.of i * FreeMonoid.of i) :
    (π C).map f = (π C).map (𝟙 L)
proof:
:= by
  
  let gi₁ : C := (L.toList)[i]'(by grind)
  let gi₂ : C := (L.toList)[i + 1]'(by grind)
  let R := FreeSListQuiv.ι _ |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.drop (i + 2) L.toList
  let P := FreeSListQuiv.ι _ |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take i L.toList
  
  have :
    L = (P>>).obj (gi₁ ::_ (gi₂ ::_ R)) := by
    apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
    simp [gi₁, gi₂, P, R]
  let g := eqToHom this.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom this
  suffices (π C).map g = (π C).map (𝟙 _) by
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, Functor.map_id, g] at this
    rw [eqToHom_comp_iff, comp_eqToHom_iff] at this
    simpa using this
  
  let u₀ := FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₂ R
  let u₁ := FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₁ R
  let f₀ := u₀ ≫ u₁
  
  have g_eq :
      g = ((FreeSListQuiv.ι _ |>.obj <|
        asSListQuiv <| List.take i L.toList)) ++ₘ f₀ := by
    apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq
    have : w₀.app f = w₀.app g := by simp [g]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, weight.weight_comp, w₀_prependPath_map, toList_length,
      FreeSListQuiv.ι_length, asSlist₀_length, List.length_take, FreeSListQuiv.toList_length,
      w₀_swap, FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, zero_add, f₀, u₀, u₁]
    grind
  
  apply Quotient.sound
  simpa [g_eq, ← Functor.map_id] using FreeSListQuiv.HomEquiv.prepend _ _ _ (.swap_swap gi₁ gi₂ _)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.map_eq_of_label_eq_braid
statement:
private theorem map_eq_of_label_eq_braid (k : ℕ) {L : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (hk : L.length = k + 1 + 1) (f : L ⟶ L)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k + 1) (hi' : i + 1 < k + 1)
    (hwf : w₀.app f = (FreeMonoid.of (i + 1) * FreeMonoid.of i) ^ 3) :
    (π C).map f = (π C).map (𝟙 L)
proof:
:= by
  
  let gi₁ : C := (L.toList)[i]'(by grind)
  let gi₂ : C := (L.toList)[i + 1]'(by grind)
  let gi₃ : C := (L.toList)[i + 2]'(by grind)
  let P := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take i L.toList
  let R := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.drop (i + 3) L.toList
  
  have :
      L = (P>>).obj (gi₁ ::_ gi₂ ::_ (gi₃ ::_ R)) := by
    apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
    simp [P, R, gi₁, gi₂, gi₃]
  
  let g := eqToHom this.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom this
  suffices (π C).map g = (π C).map (𝟙 _) by
    simpa [Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, Functor.map_id, g, eqToHom_comp_iff,
      comp_eqToHom_iff] using this
  
  
  let f₀ :=
    (gi₁ ::_ₘ (FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₃ R)) ≫
      FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₃ (gi₂ ::_ R) ≫
      (gi₃ ::_ₘ FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₂ R) ≫
      (FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₂ (gi₁ ::_ R)) ≫
      (gi₂ ::_ₘ FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₁ R) ≫
      (FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₁ (gi₃ ::_ R))
  
  have g_eq : g = (P>>).map f₀ := by
    apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, weight.weight_comp, w₀_prependPath_map, toList_length,
      w₀_consPath_map, w₀_swap, FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, zero_add, f₀]
    have P_length : P.length = i := by grind
    have : w₀.app f = w₀.app g := by simp [g]
    simp only [← this, hwf, P_length, add_comm 1 i]
    grind [pow_three]
  
  simp only [g_eq, ← Functor.map_id]
  apply prepend_congr
  have := swap_hexagon gi₁ gi₂ gi₃ ((π C).obj R)
  simp only [π_obj_cons, Functor.map_comp, π_map_cons, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp, Functor.map_id, f₀, swap_π_def]
  simp [←reassoc_of% this, swap_swap_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.map_eq_of_label_eq_braid_inv
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_label_eq_braid_inv (k : ℕ) {L : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (hk : L.length = k + 1 + 1) (f : L ⟶ L)
    (i : ℕ) (hi' : i + 1 < k + 1)
    (hwf : w₀.app f = (FreeMonoid.of i * FreeMonoid.of (i + 1)) ^ 3) :
    (π C).map f = (π C).map (𝟙 L)
proof:
:= by
  
  let gi₁ : C := (L.toList)[i]'(by grind)
  let gi₂ : C := (L.toList)[i + 1]'(by grind)
  let gi₃ : C := (L.toList)[i + 2]'(by grind)
  let P := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take i L.toList
  let R := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.drop (i + 3) L.toList
  
  have :
      L = (P>>).obj
        (gi₁ ::_ gi₂ ::_ gi₃ ::_  R) := by
    apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
    simp [P, R, gi₁, gi₂, gi₃]
  
  let g := eqToHom this.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom this
  suffices (π C).map g = (π C).map (𝟙 _) by
    simpa [Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, Functor.map_id, g, eqToHom_comp_iff,
      comp_eqToHom_iff] using this
  
  
  let u₀ := FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₂ (gi₃ ::_ R)
  let u₁ := gi₂ ::_ₘ FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₃ R
  let u₂ := FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₃ (gi₁ ::_ R)
  let u₃ := gi₃ ::_ₘ FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₁ R
  let u₄ := FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₁ (gi₂ ::_ R)
  let u₅ := gi₁ ::_ₘ FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₂ R
  let f₀ := u₀ ≫ u₁ ≫ u₂ ≫ u₃ ≫ u₄ ≫ u₅
  
  have g_eq : g = (P>>).map f₀ := by
    apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, weight.weight_comp, w₀_prependPath_map, toList_length, w₀_swap,
      FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, zero_add, w₀_consPath_map, f₀, u₀, u₁, u₂, u₃, u₄, u₅]
    have P_length : P.length = i := by grind
    have : w₀.app f = w₀.app g := by simp [g]
    simp only [← this, hwf, P_length, add_comm 1 i]
    grind [pow_three]
  
  simp only [g_eq, ← Functor.map_id]
  apply prepend_congr
  have := swap_hexagon gi₁ gi₂ gi₃ ((π C).obj R)
  simp only [π_obj_cons, Functor.map_comp, swap_π_def, π_map_cons, Functor.map_id,
    f₀, u₀, u₁, u₂, u₃, u₄, u₅]
  simp [reassoc_of% this, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.map_eq_of_label_eq_comm
statement:
private theorem map_eq_of_label_eq_comm
    (k : ℕ) {L : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (hk : L.length = k + 1 + 1) (f : L ⟶ L) (i : ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < k + 1)
    (hwf : w₀.app f = (FreeMonoid.of i * FreeMonoid.of j) ^ 2)
    (h_lt : i < j) (hij : i + 1 ≠ j) :
    (π C).map f = (π C).map (𝟙 L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt (show i + 1 < j by grind)
  
  let gi₁ : C := (L.toList)[i]'(by grind)
  let gi₂ : C := (L.toList)[i + 1]'(by grind)
  let gi₃ : C := (L.toList)[i + 1 + j + 1]'(by grind)
  let gi₄ : C := (L.toList)[i + 1 + j + 2]'(by grind)
  let P := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take i L.toList
  let Q := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take j <| List.drop (i + 2) L.toList
  let R := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.drop (i + 1 + j + 3) L.toList
  
  have : L = (P>>).obj (gi₁ ::_ gi₂ ::_ ((Q>>).obj <| gi₃ ::_ gi₄ ::_ R)) := by
    apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
    simp only [show i + 1 + j + 1 = i + 2 + j by grind, FreeSListQuiv.appendPath_toList,
      FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList, asSListQuiv_toList, FreeSListQuiv.cons_toList, List.getElem_cons_drop,
      P, gi₁, gi₂, Q, gi₃, gi₄, R]
    simp [show i + 1 + j + 2 = (i + 2 + j) + 1 by grind]
  
  let g := eqToHom this.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom this
  suffices (π C).map g = (π C).map (𝟙 _) by
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, Functor.map_id, g] at this
    rw [eqToHom_comp_iff, comp_eqToHom_iff] at this
    simpa using this
  
  let v₁ :=
    (((P>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₂ <|
        (Q>>).obj <| gi₃ ::_ gi₄ ::_ R)) ≫
      ((P>>).map <| gi₂ ::_ₘ gi₁ ::_ₘ ((Q>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₄ R)) ≫
      ((P>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₁ <|
        (Q>>).obj <| gi₄ ::_ gi₃ ::_ R ) ≫
      ((P>>).map <| gi₁ ::_ₘ gi₂ ::_ₘ (Q>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₄ gi₃ R)
  have g_eq : g = v₁ := by
    apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq
    simp only [weight.weight_comp, w₀_prependPath_map, toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length,
      asSlist₀_length, List.length_take, FreeSListQuiv.toList_length, w₀_swap,
      FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, zero_add, w₀_consPath_map, List.length_drop, P, Q, v₁]
    have P_length : P.length = i := by grind
    have : w₀.app f = w₀.app g := by simp [g]
    grind [pow_two]
  
  simp only [g_eq, ← Functor.map_id, v₁, ← Functor.map_comp]
  apply prepend_congr
  have := swap_natural gi₁ gi₂ ((π C).map <| (Q>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₄ R)
  simp only [π_obj_cons, Functor.map_comp, swap_π_def, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp, π_map_cons, reassoc_of% this, swap_swap_assoc, Functor.map_id]
  simp only [← Functor.map_id, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply prepend_congr
  simp [swap_π_def, π_obj_cons]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.map_eq_of_label_eq_comm_inv
statement:
private theorem map_eq_of_label_eq_comm_inv
    (k : ℕ) {L : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (hk : L.length = k + 1 + 1) (f : L ⟶ L) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < k + 1) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < k + 1)
    (hwf : w₀.app f = (FreeMonoid.of i * FreeMonoid.of j) ^ 2)
    (hji : j + 1 ≠ i)
    (hij : j < i) :
    (π C).map f = (π C).map (𝟙 L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt (show j + 1 < i by grind)
  
  let gi₁ : C := (L.toList)[j]'(by grind)
  let gi₂ : C := (L.toList)[j + 1]'(by grind)
  let gi₃ : C := (L.toList)[j + 1 + i + 1]'(by grind)
  let gi₄ : C := (L.toList)[j + 1 + i + 2]'(by grind)
  let P := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take j L.toList
  let Q := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.take i <| List.drop (j + 2) L.toList
  let R := FreeSListQuiv.ι C |>.obj <| asSListQuiv <| List.drop (j + 1 + i + 3) L.toList
  
  have :
    L = (P>>).obj (gi₁ ::_ gi₂ ::_ ((Q>>).obj <| gi₃ ::_ gi₄ ::_ R)) := by
    apply FreeSListQuiv.injective_toList
    simp only [show j + 1 + i + 1 = j + 2 + i by grind, FreeSListQuiv.appendPath_toList,
      FreeSListQuiv.ι_toList, asSListQuiv_toList, FreeSListQuiv.cons_toList, List.getElem_cons_drop,
      P, gi₁, gi₂, Q, gi₃, gi₄, R]
    simp [show j + 1 + i + 2 = (j + 2 + i) + 1 by grind]
  
  let g := eqToHom this.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom this
  suffices (π C).map g = (π C).map (𝟙 _) by
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map, Functor.map_id, g] at this
    rw [eqToHom_comp_iff, comp_eqToHom_iff] at this
    simpa using this
  
  let v₁ :=
      ((P>>).map <| gi₁ ::_ₘ gi₂ ::_ₘ ((Q>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₄ R)) ≫
        ((P>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₁ gi₂ <| (Q>>).obj <| gi₄ ::_ gi₃ ::_ R) ≫
        ((P>>).map <| gi₂ ::_ₘ gi₁ ::_ₘ ((Q>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₄ gi₃ R)) ≫
        ((P>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₂ gi₁ <| (Q>>).obj <| gi₃ ::_ gi₄ ::_ R)
  have g_eq : g = v₁ := by
    apply eq_of_w₀_app_eq
    simp only [weight.weight_comp, w₀_prependPath_map, toList_length, FreeSListQuiv.ι_length,
      asSlist₀_length, List.length_take, FreeSListQuiv.toList_length, w₀_consPath_map,
      List.length_drop, w₀_swap, FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, zero_add, P, Q, v₁]
    have P_length : P.length = j := by grind
    have : w₀.app f = w₀.app g := by simp [g]
    grind [pow_two]
  
  simp only [g_eq, ← Functor.map_id, v₁, ← Functor.map_comp]
  apply prepend_congr
  have := swap_natural gi₁ gi₂ ((π C).map <| (Q>>).map <| FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₄ R)
  
  
  simp only [π_obj_cons, Functor.map_comp, π_map_cons, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp, swap_π_def, ← reassoc_of% this, Functor.map_id]
  have : (π C).map ((Q>>).map
      (FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₃ gi₄ R ≫ FreeSListQuiv.swap gi₄ gi₃ R)) = 𝟙 _ := by
    simp only [← Functor.map_id]
    apply prepend_congr
    simp [swap_π_def, π_obj_cons]
  
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, this, ← Functor.map_id]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.eq_of_path_of_length_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem eq_of_path_of_length_eq_zero {i j : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (f g : i ⟶ j) (hk : i.length = 0) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain h : j.length = 0 := (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f ▸ hk)
  obtain rfl : i = []_ := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hk
  obtain rfl : j = []_ := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h
  obtain rfl : f = 𝟙 _ := FreeSListQuiv.eq_id_of_hom_nil f
  obtain rfl : g = 𝟙 _ := FreeSListQuiv.eq_id_of_hom_nil g
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.SList.eq_of_path_of_length_eq_one
statement:
private theorem eq_of_path_of_length_eq_one {i j : FreeSListQuiv C}
    (f g : i ⟶ j) (hk : i.length = 1) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain h : j.length = 1 := (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f ▸ hk)
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_one_iff.mp hk
  obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_one_iff.mp h
  cases f using FreeSListQuiv.cases_hom_singleton
  cases g using FreeSListQuiv.cases_hom_singleton
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.SList.π_map_eq_of_w₂_eq
statement:
theorem π_map_eq_of_w₂_eq {i j : FreeSListQuiv C} (f g : i ⟶ j)
    (h : w₂.app f = w₂.app g) :
    (π C).map f = (π C).map g
proof:
:= by
  generalize hk : i.length = k
  
  obtain _ | _ | k := k
  · simp [eq_of_path_of_length_eq_zero f g hk]
  · simp [eq_of_path_of_length_eq_one f g hk]
  ·                                                                      
                                
    replace h := congr(Ainf.groupToMonoid $h)
    rw [← w₂_app_eq'' k f (by grind), ← w₂_app_eq'' k g (by grind)] at h
    have h := injective_AnToAinfMonoid _ h
    simp only [wFin_app_eq'] at h
    have := Quotient.exact h
    clear h
    clear h
    generalize hwf : (w₀Fin k).app f = wf at this
    generalize hwg : (w₀Fin k).app g = wg at this
                                                                 
                                                                
                                                      
    induction this generalizing i j with
    | of x y h =>
      
      cases h with | intro i' j' =>
      obtain rfl : i = j := by
        apply eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' k (f := 𝟙 i) (g := g) (by grind)
        simpa using hwg.symm
      obtain rfl : g = 𝟙 _ := by
        apply eq_of_w₀Fin_eq k (by grind)
        simpa
      clear hwg
      simp only [CoxeterMatrix.Aₙ, Matrix.of_apply, pow_ite, pow_one] at hwf
      rcases i' with ⟨i', hi'⟩
      rcases j' with ⟨j', hj'⟩
      replace hwf := congr((valEmb _) $hwf)
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff, apply_ite (f := valEmb (k + 1)), map_mul,
        FreeMonoid.lift_eval_of, map_pow, valEmb_w₀Fin (hn := hk)] at hwf
      split_ifs at hwf with h' h''
                                                                                       
                                                                                
                                                                                 
                 
      · subst h'
        exact map_eq_of_label_eq_sq k hk i' hi' f hwf
      · clear h'
        rcases h'' with rfl | rfl
        · exact map_eq_of_label_eq_braid k hk f j' hj' hi' hwf
        · exact map_eq_of_label_eq_braid_inv k hk f i' hj' hwf
      · push_neg at h' h''
        obtain ⟨hji, hij⟩ := h''
        by_cases i' < j'
        · exact map_eq_of_label_eq_comm k hk f i' j' (by grind) hwf
            (by grind) hij
        · refine map_eq_of_label_eq_comm_inv k hk f i' hi' j' hj' hwf hji
            (by grind)
    | refl x =>
      subst hwf
      obtain rfl : f = g := eq_of_w₀Fin_eq k (by grind) hwg.symm
      exact .refl _
    | @symm x y r hr =>
      symm
      exact hr _ _ hk hwg hwf
    | @trans x y z r₁ r₂ hr₁ hr₂ =>
                                                                
                                                                  
                                                              
                                                                      
                                                           
      obtain ⟨j₀, f' , hf'⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq i k hk y
      obtain rfl : j = j₀ := by
        subst_vars
        exact eq_of_w₀Fin_congen_rel _ hk r₁
      have := hr₁ f f' hk hwf hf'
      grind
    | @mul w y x z r r' hr hr' =>
                                                                    
                                                                 
                             
      obtain ⟨j₀, f₀ , hf₀⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq i k hk w
      obtain ⟨j₁, f₁ , hf₁⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq j₀ k
        (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₀ ▸ hk) x
      obtain rfl : j = j₁ :=
        eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' (f := f) (g := f₀ ≫ f₁) k hk (by grind)
      obtain ⟨k₀, g₀ , hg₀⟩ := exists_hom_of_weight_eq i k hk y
      obtain ⟨k₁, g₁ , hg₁⟩ :=
        exists_hom_of_weight_eq k₀ k (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom g₀ ▸ hk) z
      obtain rfl : j = k₁ :=
        eq_of_w₀Fin_eq' (f := g) (g := g₀ ≫ g₁) k hk (by grind)
      obtain rfl : j₀ = k₀ := by
        subst_vars
        exact eq_of_w₀Fin_congen_rel k hk r
      have := hr f₀ g₀ hk hf₀ hg₀
      have := hr' f₁ g₁ (FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₀ ▸ hk) hf₁ hg₁
      obtain rfl : f = f₀ ≫ f₁ := eq_of_w₀Fin_eq k hk (by grind)
      obtain rfl : g = g₀ ≫ g₁ := eq_of_w₀Fin_eq k hk (by grind)
      grind

name: CategoryTheory.SList.injective_toAinf_app
statement:
@[grind inj]
theorem injective_toAinf_app {x y : SList C} : Function.Injective
    (@(toAinf (C := C)).app (x := x) (y := y))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  cases f with |_ f
  cases g with |_ g
  exact π_map_eq_of_w₂_eq _ _ (by simpa using h)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.hom_eq_iff_toAinf_eq

theorem hom_eq_iff_toAinf_eq {x y : SList C} (f g : x ⟶ y) :

name: CategoryTheory.SList.injective_toPerm_app
statement:
@[grind inj]
theorem injective_toPerm_app {x y : SList C} : Function.Injective
    (@(toPerm (C := C)).app (x := x) (y := y))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  cases f with |_ f
  cases g with |_ g
  simp only [toPerm, weight.postComp_app] at h
  exact injective_toAinf_app <| injective_AinfToPerm h

name: CategoryTheory.SList.hom_eq_iff_toPerm_eq
statement:
theorem hom_eq_iff_toPerm_eq {x y : SList C} (f g : x ⟶ y) :
    f = g ↔ toPerm.app f = toPerm.app g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [h], fun h => by rw [injective_toPerm_app h]⟩

name: CategoryTheory.SList.hom_eq_iff_toEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem hom_eq_iff_toEquiv_eq {x y : SList C} (f g : x ⟶ y) :
    f = g ↔ (toEquiv f) = (toEquiv g) where
  mp h
proof:
:= by rw [h]
  mpr h := by
    rw [hom_eq_iff_toPerm_eq]
    ext k
    by_cases! hl : k < y.length
    · exact congr($h ⟨k, hl⟩)
    · rw [toPerm_app_eq_of_lt _ _ hl, toPerm_app_eq_of_lt _ _ ((length_eq_of_hom f) ▸ hl)]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.getElem_toList_toEquiv
statement:
theorem getElem_toList_toEquiv {x y : SList C} (f : x ⟶ y) (i : Fin y.length) :
     y.toList[i] = x.toList[(toEquiv f) i]
proof:
:= by
  cases f with | @h x y f =>
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, toEquiv_apply_val, π_obj_toList, toPerm,
    weight.postComp_app, toAinf_π]
  exact getElem_toList_eq_perm_apply f _ _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.exists_lift_perm
proof:
:= by
  
  cases x with | h x =>
  generalize h : x.length = k
  obtain _ | _ | k := k
  · obtain rfl : x = []_ := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h
    obtain rfl : φ = 1 := by grind
    use []~, 𝟙 _
    simp [nil_def]
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_one_iff.mp h
    obtain rfl : φ = 1 := by grind
    use u ::~ []~, 𝟙 _
    simp [nil_def, π_obj_cons]
  · 
    
    
    have := exists_hom_of_weight_eq (C := C) x k h
    let u := hom1MulEquiv (k + 1)
    let v := (CoxeterMatrix.Aₙ (k + 1)).monoidToGroupMulEquiv
    let w := v.trans u
    have e₀ : ((π C).obj x).length = k + 1 + 1 := by grind
    let ψ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k + 1 + 1)) := Equiv.permCongrHom (finCongr e₀) φ
    let k₀ := w.symm ψ
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := PresentedMonoid.surjective_mk k₀
    obtain ⟨y₀, f₀, hf₀⟩ := this a
    use (π C).obj y₀, (π C).map f₀
    ext i
    simp only [toEquiv, toPerm, weight.postComp_app, toAinf_π, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.trans_apply,
      finCongr_apply]
    have app_eq'' := congr(Ainf.monoidToGroup $(w₂_app_eq'' (C := C) k f₀ (by grind)))
    have := congr(PresentedMonoid.mk (CoxeterMatrix.Aₙ _).monoidRelations $hf₀)
    rw [← wFin_app_eq'] at this
    rw [CoxeterMatrix.monoidToGroup_groupToMonoid] at app_eq''
    rw [← app_eq'', this]
    simp only [AnToAinfMonoid, ha, MulEquiv.symm_trans_apply, Equiv.permCongrHom_coe,
      CoxeterMatrix.monoidToGroupMulEquiv_symm_apply, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      CoxeterMatrix.monoidToGroup_groupToMonoid, k₀, v, u, ψ, w]
    have := FreeSListQuiv.length_eq_of_hom f₀
    have := Aₙ_to_perm_apply_eq (n := k + 1) (i := i.cast (by grind))
      ((hom1MulEquiv (k + 1)).symm ((finCongr e₀).permCongr φ))
    simp only [Fin.val_cast] at this
    rw [← this]
    simp [hom1MulEquiv]

        Equiv.sumCongr (ι.{v, u} X).symm (ι.{v, u} Y).symm |>.trans <|

name: CategoryTheory.SList.ofFiniteHomOfEquiv_refl
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma ofFiniteHomOfEquiv_refl : ofFiniteHomOfEquiv (.refl X) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [hom_eq_iff_toEquiv_eq]
  ext i
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (ofFinite.ι X).surjective i
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.ofFiniteHomOfEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma ofFiniteHomOfEquiv_trans (e₁ : X ≃ Y) (e₂ : Y ≃ Z) :
    ofFiniteHomOfEquiv (e₁.trans e₂) = ofFiniteHomOfEquiv e₁ ≫ ofFiniteHomOfEquiv e₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [hom_eq_iff_toEquiv_eq]
  ext i
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (ofFinite.ι Z).surjective i
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.ofFiniteHomOfEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp, push]
lemma ofFiniteHomOfEquiv_symm (e : X ≃ Y) :
    inv (ofFiniteHomOfEquiv e) = ofFiniteHomOfEquiv e.symm
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply IsIso.eq_inv_of_inv_hom_id
  rw [hom_eq_iff_toEquiv_eq]
  ext i : 1
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (ofFinite.ι Y).surjective i
  simp

    (Functor.Monoidal.μIso ofFiniteGrpdFunctor X Y).hom =
    SList.liftEquiv
      (ofFinite.ι _ |>.symm.trans <|
        (FintypeGrpd.tensorObjEquiv X Y).symm.trans <|
        (Equiv.sumCongr (ofFinite.ι _) (ofFinite.ι _)).trans <|

        (Equiv.sumCongr (ofFinite.ι _).symm (ofFinite.ι _).symm).trans <|
        (FintypeGrpd.tensorObjEquiv X Y).trans <| ofFinite.ι _ )
      (fun _ ↦ rfl)

      (Ψ _ _ <| .inl <| ofFinite.ι _ x) = ofFinite.ι _ (FintypeGrpd.inl _ _ x)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toEquiv_ofFiniteGrpdFunctor_δ_right
statement:

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.hom_ι
statement:

lemma toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.hom_ι (x : SList J) (i : Fin x.length) :

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor_map_ι_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor_map_ι_symm {x y : SList J} (f : x ⟶ y) (i : Fin y.length) :

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor_map_ι

lemma toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor_map_ι {x y : SList J} (f : x ⟶ y) (i : Fin x.length) :

name: CategoryTheory.SList.ofFiniteGrpdOverFunctor_μIso_hom_left_def
statement:
lemma ofFiniteGrpdOverFunctor_μIso_hom_left_def (X Y : SList J) :
    (Functor.Monoidal.μIso (toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor J) X Y).hom.left =
    (FintypeGrpd.mkIso <|
      FintypeGrpd.tensorObjEquiv _ _ |>.symm.trans <|
      Equiv.sumCongr
        (toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.ι X).symm
        (toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.ι Y).symm |>.trans <|
      Ψ .. |>.trans <| toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.ι (X ⊗ Y)).hom

      Equiv.sumCongr
        (toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.ι X).symm
        (toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.ι Y).symm |>.trans <|
      Ψ .. |>.trans <| toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor.ι (X ⊗ Y)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor_μ_iso_hom_left

lemma toFintypeGrpdOverFunctor_μ_iso_hom_left :

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_map_cons_map
statement:
lemma J_map_cons_map (c : C) {l l' : SList C} (f : l ⟶ l') :
    (J C).map ((cons c).map f) =
      (JObjConsIso _ _).hom ≫
      ((of c) ◁ (J C).map f) ≫
      (JObjConsIso _ _).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_map_swap
statement:
lemma J_map_swap (c c' : C) (l : SList C) :
    (J C).map (β~ c c' l) =
    (JObjConsIso _ _).hom ≫
      ((of c) ◁ (JObjConsIso _ _).hom) ≫
      ((α_ _ _ _).symm ≪≫ (whiskerRightIso (β_ _ _) _) ≪≫ (α_ _ _ _)).hom ≫
      ((of c') ◁ (JObjConsIso _ _).inv) ≫
      (JObjConsIso _ _).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.μIso_hom_app_nil_app
statement:
@[local simp]
lemma μIso_hom_app_nil_app (t : SList C) :
    ((μIso C).hom.app []~).app t =
      JObjNilIso.hom ▷ _ ≫ (λ_ _).hom ≫ (J C).map ((λ_ _).inv ≫
        unitIsoNil.hom ▷ t)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.μIso_hom_app_cons_app
statement:
@[local simp]
lemma μIso_hom_app_cons_app (c : C) (l t : SList C) :
    ((μIso C).hom.app (c ::~ l)).app t =
    (JObjConsIso _ _).hom ▷ _ ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ (of c) ◁ ((μIso C).hom.app l).app t ≫
      (JObjConsIso _ _).inv ≫ (J C).map (tensorObjConsIso c l _).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.μIso_natural_left
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := local simp)]
lemma μIso_natural_left {x y : SList C}
    (f : x ⟶ y) (z : SList C) :
    (J C).map f ▷ (J C).obj z ≫ ((μIso C).hom.app y).app z =
    ((μIso C).hom.app x).app z ≫ (J C).map (f ▷ z)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [-NatTrans.naturality] using congr_app ((μIso C).hom.naturality f) z

name: CategoryTheory.SList.μIso_natural_right
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := local simp)]
lemma μIso_natural_right
    (z : SList C)
    {x y : SList C} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (J C).obj z ◁ (J C).map f ≫ ((μIso C).hom.app z).app y =
    ((μIso C).hom.app z).app x ≫ (J C).map (z ◁ f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [-NatTrans.naturality] using ((μIso C).hom.app z).naturality f

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_μ_app_nil_app
statement:
@[local simp]
lemma J_μ_app_nil_app (t : SList C) :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) []~ t =
      JObjNilIso.hom ▷ _ ≫ (λ_ _).hom ≫ (J C).map ((λ_ _).inv ≫
        unitIsoNil.hom ▷ t)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_μ_app_cons_app
statement:
@[local simp]
lemma J_μ_app_cons_app (c : C) (l t : SList C) :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) (c ::~ l) t =
    (JObjConsIso _ _).hom ▷ _ ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ (of c) ◁ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) l t ≫
      (JObjConsIso _ _).inv ≫ (J C).map (tensorObjConsIso c l _).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_ε
statement:
lemma J_ε :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (J C) = JObjNilIso.inv ≫ (J C).map unitIsoNil.inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_η
statement:
lemma J_η :
    Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (J C) = (J C).map unitIsoNil.hom ≫ JObjNilIso.hom

name: CategoryTheory.SList.braiding_inv_J_obj_nil_right
statement:
lemma braiding_inv_J_obj_nil_right (x : FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C) :
    (β_ x ((J C).obj []~)).inv =
    JObjNilIso.hom ▷ x ≫ (λ_ x).hom ≫ (ρ_ x).inv ≫ x ◁ JObjNilIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  have := BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right x JObjNilIso.hom =≫ JObjNilIso.inv ▷ x
  simp at this
  rw [← IsIso.inv_eq_inv]
  simp [← this]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.braiding_hom_J_obj_nil_right
statement:
lemma braiding_hom_J_obj_nil_right (x : FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C) :
    (β_ x ((J C).obj []~)).hom =
     x ◁ JObjNilIso.hom ≫ (ρ_ x).hom ≫ (λ_ x).inv ≫ JObjNilIso.inv ▷ x
proof:
:= by
  have := BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right x JObjNilIso.hom =≫ JObjNilIso.inv ▷ x
  simp at this
  rw [← IsIso.inv_eq_inv]
  simp [← this]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_braided_nil_nil
statement:
lemma J_braided_nil_nil :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) []~ []~ ≫ (J C).map (β_ []~ []~).hom =
    (β_ ((J C).obj []~) ((J C).obj []~)).hom ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) []~ []~
proof:
:= by
  simp only [J_μ_app_nil_app,
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    Iso.map_hom_inv_id_assoc, braiding_hom_app_nil]
  simp_rw [← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left, ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left_assoc,
    J_μ_app_nil_app, J_ε, Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp,
    ← BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right_assoc, braiding_tensorUnit_right]
  simp_rw [← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight_assoc,
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.map_inv_hom_id_assoc,
    ← whisker_exchange_assoc]
  simp [-Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality, -Functor.LaxMonoidal.right_unitality,
    ← unitors_equal, ← cancel_epi ((J C).obj []~ ◁ JObjNilIso.inv), whisker_exchange_assoc,
    ← unitors_inv_equal]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_braided_nil_left
statement:
lemma J_braided_nil_left (x : SList C) :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) x []~ ≫ (J C).map (β_ x []~).hom =
    (β_ ((J C).obj x) ((J C).obj []~)).hom ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) []~ x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using SList.cons_induction with
  | nil => exact J_braided_nil_nil
  | cons c x hr =>
    simp only [J_μ_app_cons_app]
    have := hr =≫ (J C).map (β_ x []~).inv
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.map_hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] at this
    rw [this]
    simp only [Category.assoc, J_μ_app_nil_app]
    rw [← cancel_epi ((JObjConsIso c x).inv ▷ (J C).obj []~)]
    simp only [inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc, BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left_assoc,
      whisker_exchange_assoc, whiskerRight_tensor_assoc, leftUnitor_naturality_assoc]
    rw [← cancel_epi (α_ (of c) ((J C).obj x) ((J C).obj []~)).inv]
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, BraidedCategory.hexagon_reverse_assoc,
      SList.braiding_hom_app_nil, whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc,
      SList.braiding_inv_app_nil,
      SList.whiskerLeft_cons, Category.assoc, cancel_epi]
    
    
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, whiskerLeft_comp, Iso.map_inv_hom_id_assoc, Category.assoc]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, cancel_mono]
    simp only [Category.assoc, braiding_hom_J_obj_nil_right]
    simp only [comp_whiskerRight, whisker_assoc, leftUnitor_inv_whiskerRight, Category.assoc,
      triangle_assoc_comp_right_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, cancel_epi]
    simp_rw [← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hom_inv_whiskerRight_assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight_assoc]
    simp only [← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, inv_hom_whiskerRight, id_whiskerRight,
      Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, J_map_cons_map, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      ← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc]
    have := (JObjConsIso c x).inv ≫= J_map_cons_map c ((ρ_ x).inv)
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at this
    simp only [← Functor.map_comp, whiskerLeft_hom_inv, Category.comp_id,
      ← reassoc_of% this, ← cancel_epi (JObjConsIso c x).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
      ← Functor.map_id]
    congr 1
    
    simp [show (ρ_ _) = SList.rightUnitor _ by rfl,
      SList.rightUnitor, tensorObjConsIso, eqToHom_map]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.J_braided_nil_right
statement:
lemma J_braided_nil_right (x : SList C) :
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) []~ x ≫ (J C).map (β_ []~ x).hom =
    (β_ ((J C).obj []~) ((J C).obj x)).hom ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) x []~
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [SymmetricCategory.braiding_swap_eq_inv_braiding]
  have := J_braided_nil_left x =≫  (J C).map (β_ x []~).inv
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.map_hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] at this
  rw [this]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.whiskerLeft_map_hom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
private lemma whiskerLeft_map_hom_inv
    {C D : Type*} [Category* C] [Category* D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (x : D) {y z : C} (F : C ⥤ D) (e : y ≅ z) :
    x ◁ F.map e.hom ≫ x ◁ F.map e.inv = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.whiskerLeft_map_inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
private lemma whiskerLeft_map_inv_hom
    {C D : Type*} [Category* C] [Category* D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (x : D) {y z : C} (F : C ⥤ D) (e : y ≅ z) :
    x ◁ F.map e.inv ≫ x ◁ F.map e.hom = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft_inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
private lemma whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft_inv_hom
    {D : Type*} [Category* D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (x y : D) {z t : D} (e : z ≅ t) :
    x ◁ y ◁ e.inv ≫ x ◁ y ◁ e.hom = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft_hom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
private lemma whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft_hom_inv
    {D : Type*} [Category* D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (x y : D) {z t : D} (e : z ≅ t) :
    x ◁ y ◁ e.hom ≫ x ◁ y ◁ e.inv = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.whiskerLeft_hom_inv_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
private lemma whiskerLeft_hom_inv_whiskerRight
    {D : Type*} [Category* D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (x : D) {y z : D} (e : y ≅ z) (t : D) :
  x ◁ e.hom ▷ t ≫ x ◁ e.inv ▷ t = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.whiskerLeft_inv_hom_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
private lemma whiskerLeft_inv_hom_whiskerRight
    {D : Type*} [Category* D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (x : D) {y z : D} (e : y ≅ z) (t : D) :
  x ◁ e.inv ▷ t ≫ x ◁ e.hom ▷ t = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.SList.unitIso_hom_app_nil
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma unitIso_hom_app_nil :
    (unitIso C).hom.app []~ =
    unitIsoNil.inv ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (normalization C) ≫
      (normalization C).map JObjNilIso.inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.unitIso_hom_app_cons
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma unitIso_hom_app_cons (c : C) (l : SList C) :
    (unitIso C).hom.app (c ::~ l) =
    (c ::~ₘ (λ_ l).inv) ≫
    (c ::~ₘ unitIsoNil.hom ▷ l) ≫
      (tensorObjConsIso c []~ l).inv ≫
      [c]~ ◁ (unitIso C).hom.app l ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (normalization C) (of c) ((J C).obj l) ≫
      (normalization C).map (JObjConsIso c l).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.unitIso_inv_app_nil
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma unitIso_inv_app_nil :
    (unitIso C).inv.app []~ =
      (normalization C).map JObjNilIso.hom ≫
       Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (normalization C) ≫ unitIsoNil.hom

name: CategoryTheory.SList.unitIso_inv_app_cons
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma unitIso_inv_app_cons (c : C) (l : SList C) :
    (unitIso C).inv.app (c ::~ l) =
    (normalization C).map (JObjConsIso c l).hom ≫
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (normalization C) (of c) ((J C).obj l) ≫
      [c]~ ◁ (unitIso C).inv.app l ≫
      (tensorObjConsIso c []~ l).hom ≫
      (c ::~ₘ unitIsoNil.inv ▷ l) ≫
      (c ::~ₘ (λ_ l).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsIso.inv_eq_inv]
  simp only [← Functor.map_inv, IsIso.Iso.inv_hom, IsIso.inv_comp]
  simp [unitIso]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.unitIso_inv_app_singleton
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma unitIso_inv_app_singleton (c : C) :
    (unitIso C).inv.app ([c]~) =
    (normalization C).map ((JObjConsIso c []~).hom ≫ of c ◁ JObjNilIso.hom ≫ (ρ_ (of c)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj, unitIso_inv_app_cons, normalization_of,
    unitIso_inv_app_nil, whiskerLeft_comp,
    Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp, Functor.Monoidal.map_whiskerLeft,
    Functor.Monoidal.map_rightUnitor,
    Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc]
  simp only [whiskerLeft_cons, whiskerLeft_nil, Functor.OplaxMonoidal.left_unitality,
    unitors_inv_equal, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, whiskerRight_id,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hom_inv_whiskerRight_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    Functor.OplaxMonoidal.left_unitality_hom_assoc]
  congr 3
  simp only [← unitors_inv_equal]
  simp [rightUnitor_cons]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.unitIso_hom_app_singleton
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma unitIso_hom_app_singleton (c : C) :
    (unitIso C).hom.app ([c]~) =
    (normalization C).map ((ρ_ (of c)).inv ≫ of c ◁ JObjNilIso.inv ≫ (JObjConsIso c []~).inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsIso.inv_eq_inv, ← NatIso.isIso_inv_app, IsIso.Iso.inv_hom, unitIso_inv_app_singleton]
  simp [← Functor.map_inv]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.counitIso_hom_app_unit
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma counitIso_hom_app_unit :
    (counitIso C).hom.app (𝟙_ (FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C)) =
      (J C).map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (normalization C)) ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (J C)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.counitIso_inv_app_unit
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma counitIso_inv_app_unit :
    (counitIso C).inv.app (𝟙_ (FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C)) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (J C) ≫ (J C).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (normalization C))

name: CategoryTheory.SList.counitIso_hom_app_of
statement:
@[simp]
lemma counitIso_hom_app_of (c : C) :
    (counitIso C).hom.app (of c) =
    (JObjConsIso c _).hom ≫ (of c) ◁ JObjNilIso.hom ≫ (ρ_ _).hom

name: CategoryTheory.SList.counitIso_inv_app_of
statement:
@[simp]
lemma counitIso_inv_app_of (c : C) :

    (ρ_ _).inv ≫ (of c) ◁ JObjNilIso.inv ≫ (JObjConsIso c _).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.counitIso_hom_app_tensor
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma counitIso_hom_app_tensor (x y : FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C) :
    (counitIso C).hom.app (x ⊗ y) =
    (J C).map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (normalization C) x y) ≫
    Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (J C) ((normalization C).obj x) ((normalization C).obj y) ≫
      (((counitIso C).hom.app x) ⊗ₘ ((counitIso C).hom.app y))

name: CategoryTheory.SList.counitIso_inv_app_tensor
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma counitIso_inv_app_tensor (x y : FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C) :

    (((counitIso C).inv.app x) ⊗ₘ ((counitIso C).inv.app y)) ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (J C) ((normalization C).obj x) ((normalization C).obj y) ≫
        (J C).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (normalization C) x y)

name: CategoryTheory.SList.monoidalLiftNatTrans_app_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma monoidalLiftNatTrans_app_singleton
    {F G : SList C ⥤ D} [F.Braided] [G.LaxBraided] (φ : ∀ (c : C), F.obj [c]~ ⟶ G.obj [c]~)
    (c : C) :
    (monoidalLiftNatTrans φ).app [c]~ = φ c
proof:
:= by
  letI F' : FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C ⥤ D := (equivalence C).inverse ⋙ F
  letI G' : FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory C ⥤ D := (equivalence C).inverse ⋙ G
  letI φ' : ∀ (c : C), F'.obj (of c) ⟶ G'.obj (of c) := φ
  letI α₀ : F' ⟶ G' := FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory.liftNatTrans φ'
  simp only [monoidalLiftNatTrans, equivalence_functor, equivalence_inverse, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj, Functor.leftUnitor_inv_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app,
    Functor.associator_hom_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.associator_inv_app,
    Functor.leftUnitor_hom_app, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  change F.map ((equivalence C).unit.app [c]~) ≫
    α₀.app ((J C).obj [c]~) ≫ G.map ((equivalence C).unitInv.app [c]~) = φ c
  let nat₁ := α₀.naturality (JObjConsIso c []~ ≪≫ whiskerLeftIso (of c) JObjNilIso ≪≫ ρ_ _).hom
  simp [-NatTrans.naturality, G', F'] at nat₁
  have := (equivalence C).unitInv_app_inverse ((of c))
  dsimp [normalization_of] at this
  rw [this]
  dsimp [equivalence]
  rw [unitIso_hom_app_singleton]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, normalization_of, equivalence_inverse, counitIso_hom_app_of, ← nat₁,
    liftNatTrans_app_of, Category.assoc, F', α₀, φ']
  simp [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, normalization_of]

name: CategoryTheory.SList.monoidalNatTrans_ext_app_singleton
statement:
lemma monoidalNatTrans_ext_app_singleton
    {F G : SList C ⥤ D} [F.Braided] [G.LaxBraided]
    {α β : F ⟶ G} [α.IsMonoidal] [β.IsMonoidal]
    (h : ∀ c : C, α.app [c]~ = β.app [c]~) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  apply (Functor.whiskeringLeft .. |>.obj ((equivalence C).inverse)).map_injective
  dsimp
  apply FreeSymmetricMonoidalCategory.ext_of_monoidal
  exact h

name: CategoryTheory.SList.monoidalLiftNatTrans_comp
statement:
lemma monoidalLiftNatTrans_comp {F G H : SList C ⥤ D} [F.Braided] [G.Braided] [H.LaxBraided]
    (φ : ∀ (c : C), F.obj [c]~ ⟶ G.obj [c]~)
    (ψ : ∀ c : C, G.obj [c]~ ⟶ H.obj [c]~) :
    monoidalLiftNatTrans φ ≫ monoidalLiftNatTrans ψ =
    monoidalLiftNatTrans (fun c ↦ φ c ≫ ψ c)
proof:
:= by
  apply monoidalNatTrans_ext_app_singleton
  intro c
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.RelativePseudomonad.μ_hom_app_singleton
statement:

lemma μ_hom_app_singleton
    (x : X) :
    (μ g f).hom.app [x]~ =
    (monoidalLiftConsNilIso ((Pi.precompFunctor' Z f).obj (monoidalLift g)) x).hom ≫
      (monoidalLift g).map (monoidalLiftConsNilIso f x).inv

    (μ g f).inv.app [x]~ =

        ((Pi.precompFunctor' Z f).obj (monoidalLift g)) x).inv

name: CategoryTheory.SList.RelativePseudomonad.assoc
statement:
lemma assoc {X Y Z V : Type*} (f : X → SList Y) (g : Y → SList Z) (h : Z → SList V) :
    (monoidalLiftFunctor ..).map ((Pi.precompFunctor' _ f).map (μ h g).hom) ≫
      (monoidalLiftFunctor ..).map (Pi.precompFunctor'AssocIso ..).hom ≫
      (μ _ _).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (μ _ _).hom ((monoidalLiftFunctor ..).obj h) =
    (μ _ _).hom ≫ (Functor.whiskerLeft (((monoidalLiftFunctor ..).obj f)) (μ _ _).hom) ≫
      (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply monoidalNatTrans_ext_app_singleton
  intro c
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.RelativePseudomonad.assoc'
statement:
lemma assoc' {X Y Z V : Type*} [Category* V] [MonoidalCategory V] [SymmetricCategory V]
    (f : X → SList Y) (g : Y → SList Z) (h : Z → V) :
    (monoidalLiftFunctor ..).map ((Pi.precompFunctor' _ f).map (μ h g).hom) ≫
      (monoidalLiftFunctor ..).map (Pi.precompFunctor'AssocIso ..).hom ≫
      (μ _ _).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (μ _ _).hom ((monoidalLiftFunctor ..).obj h) =
    (μ _ _).hom ≫ (Functor.whiskerLeft (((monoidalLiftFunctor ..).obj f)) (μ _ _).hom) ≫
      (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply monoidalNatTrans_ext_app_singleton
  intro c
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.SList.RelativePseudomonad.unit
statement:
lemma unit {X Y : Type*} (f : X → SList Y) :
    (monoidalLiftFunctor ..).map (η f).hom ≫ (μ f (ι X)).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (θ X).hom ((monoidalLiftFunctor ..).obj f) =
    (Functor.leftUnitor _).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply monoidalNatTrans_ext_app_singleton
  intro c
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.isStableUnderBaseChangeAgainst_top_iff
statement:
lemma _root_.CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.isStableUnderBaseChangeAgainst_top_iff
    (P : MorphismProperty C) :

proof:
:=
  ⟨ fun h ↦ ⟨fun {_ _ _ _} _ _ _ _ h' h'' ↦

    fun _ ↦ inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Limits.hasPullback_ofHasPullbacksAgainst
statement:
lemma _root_.CategoryTheory.Limits.hasPullback_ofHasPullbacksAgainst
    {P : MorphismProperty C} {P' : MorphismProperty C} {c c' c'' : C}
    {f : c ⟶ c'} {g : c'' ⟶ c'} [P.HasPullbacksAgainst P'] (hf : P f) (hg : P' g) :
    Limits.HasPullback f g
proof:
:=
  letI : P.HasPullbacksAlong g :=
    MorphismProperty.HasPullbacksAgainst.hasPullbacksAlong g hg
  MorphismProperty.HasPullbacksAlong.hasPullback f hf

statement:
theorem mateEquiv_eq :
    (baseChangeIso S).hom =
    (Bicategory.mateEquiv (adj₁ := inrInlAdj b) (adj₂ := inrInlAdj t)
      (g := (inl C).map l.op.toLoc) (h := (inl C).map r.op.toLoc) |>.symm

  rw [Bicategory.mateEquiv_symm_apply']
  dsimp [bicategoricalComp]
  ext
  · simp [baseChangeIso, decomposeIso, isoCompOfIsPullback, inrInlAdj, inr, inl]
  · simp [baseChangeIso, decomposeIso, isoCompOfIsPullback, inrInlAdj, inr, inl,
